N31.idea: the pull decides who is in the way: the magnet drags a plain block into a lane another block still needs

N32.idea: the magnet brings the rammer: a pull moves a block into the lane of a shell - or into a lane where it is only in the way

N33.idea: push before you turn: a spinner must launch the crate out of a lane before a neighbour's departure turns it away - and the crate's new cell must not be in anyone's way

N34.idea: a turn that changes the far side: a spinner's lane runs through the portal in one facing and straight out in another
